summary: Assess GenAI, cloud, and data-lake risks with integrated security and privacy scenarios. Explore the advanced course outline.
lede: AI cybersecurity and data privacy training helps CISOs, DPOs, cloud architects, AI product leads, and security professionals assess risks in AI-enabled services. Participants map data flows and trust boundaries, model threats across GenAI and cloud environments, make privacy-by-design decisions, assign control owners, and develop incident playbooks through scenario exercises.
audienceIntro: This advanced course suits professionals who make or review security, privacy, cloud, and AI product decisions. It is designed for roles that must connect technical safeguards with data-handling obligations and incident response.
modules: NIST AI RMF and Cyber Risk
Cloud Security for AI Data Lakes
AI Control Reporting and Action Plan
prerequisites: Prior experience in cybersecurity, data protection, cloud architecture, AI product governance, or technology risk is expected. Familiarity with security controls and data-handling workflows will help you use the scenarios. Coding is not required; advanced AI assurance topics receive operational-level treatment rather than technical engineering instruction.
